# Platform records

A platform deployment records where every deployed directory came from, which platform is active, and which platform it replaced. The records are part of contract v2; their JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) are in `contract/records/`.

## DEPLOYED_FROM.json

Provenance of a deployed platform release or content package (contract v2, BUILD_PROMPT §12.10). Written by infra at the root of every deployed release and content package, root-owned and read-only. Schema file: `contract/records/deployed-from.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `kind` | one of `release`, `content` | yes | The release, or a content package. |
| `package` | string or null | yes | Content package name; null for the release. |
| `restricted` | boolean | yes | A restricted content package (deployed only into the restricted area). |
| `source` | object | yes | The source setting the deployment used. |
| `source.repo` | string | yes | Repository URL (SSH, anonymous HTTPS or file://). |
| `source.ref` | string | yes | The requested tag, branch or full commit. |
| `source.path` | string | yes | Subdirectory in the repository; empty for the root. |
| `source.tag_prefix` | string | yes | Prefix of the source's release tags. |
| `commit` | string | yes | The deployed commit. |
| `tree` | string | yes | Git tree of the deployed path at that commit. |
| `tag` | string or null | yes | Release tag with the source's prefix that the commit carries, if any. |
| `signed_tag` | object | yes | Signature check of the release tag. |
| `signed_tag.required` | boolean | yes | require_signed_tags was set. |
| `signed_tag.verified` | boolean | yes | The tag carries a valid signature of an allowed signer. |
| `signed_tag.signer` | string or null | yes | The signer's principal, when verified. |
| `platform` | object | yes | The platform release this deployment belongs to. |
| `platform.name` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `platform.version` | string | yes | SemVer of the release. |
| `platform.runtime` | one of `python-uv`, `static` | yes | Runtime of the release. |
| `platform.manifest_sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of platform-manifest.yaml. |
| `deployed_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the deployment. |

## active.json

The active platform of the lab, /etc/pinka/platform/active.json (contract v2, BUILD_PROMPT §7.14 "One platform per lab", §12.10). Written by infra when a deployment is switched on; 0644 root. Schema file: `contract/records/active-platform.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `name` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `version` | string | yes | SemVer of the active release. |
| `runtime` | one of `python-uv`, `static` | yes | Runtime of the release. |
| `manifest_sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the release's manifest. |
| `release` | object | yes | The active release. |
| `release.name` | string | yes | Directory name: the tag, or the full commit. |
| `release.commit` | string | yes | — |
| `release.tree` | string | yes | — |
| `release.tag` | string or null | yes | — |
| `release.target` | string | yes | Path of the deployed directory. |
| `release.restricted` | boolean | no | — |
| `content` | object | yes | The active content packages by name. |
| `content.*` | object | no | any key; value as described |
| `services` | array | yes | The platform's services with their profiles. |
| `services[].name` | string | yes | — |
| `services[].profile` | string | yes | — |
| `jobs` | array | yes | The platform's training jobs. |
| `jobs[].name` | string | yes | — |
| `cli` | string or null | yes | Name of the researchers' CLI, if any. |
| `names` | object | yes | Every name the deployment creates, by reserved-name namespace; they count as the platform's own in the host check of its next release. |
| `names.*` | array | no | any key; value as described |
| `activated_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the switch. |

## retired.json

A platform replaced by another (--replace-platform), `/var/lib/pinka/platforms/<platform>/retired.json`, 0600 root. pinka platform purge reads it and sets purged_at. Schema file: `contract/records/retired-platform.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `retired_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the replacement. |
| `replaced_by` | string | yes | The platform that replaced it. |
| `purged_at` | string or null | yes | UTC time of the purge, or null. |
| `active` | object | yes | Its active platform record (active-platform.schema.json) at the time of the replacement. |
